newsitem.title: INDIA: Skoda seeks India tie-up for Beta car.
newsitem.headline: Skoda seeks India tie-up for Beta car.

text.p: The Czech Republic's Skoda Plzen a.s. said on Thursday it was seeking an Indian joint venture partner to make and market its Beta car.
"Skoda will hold 60 percent in the venture," the firm's Indian representative, Martin Basta, told reporters in the Indian capital. "Production will start by April 1997," he said.

Basta, a director of the firm, said Skoda was in talks with a number of possible partners, one of them the Jindal Group. He said Skoda hoped to produce 500 cars in its first year of operation. This would double to 1,000 in the second year.
